title: Choose a reply status
summary: NestJS: Choose a reply status. Use an HTTP client to inspect the 200 status.
introduction: @HttpCode changes a handler status. POST /check returns 200 instead of the usual Nest POST status.
learningObjectives: Choose a reply status with NestJS
Use an HTTP client to inspect the 200 status

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Choose a reply status

blocks.text: HttpCode overrides the usual POST status. The returned object still controls the JSON body.
Use an HTTP client to inspect the 200 status.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A status describes the reply; it does not change the returned data.
